name: Summer Eagle Camp
description_short: A Christian day camp at Portsmouth Christian Academy in Dover, NH. In 2026 it ran eight weeks, June 15 to August 7, each week with its own theme, games, crafts, outdoor time and field trips to local attractions. Campers are grouped as Eaglets (age 3 through incoming kindergarten) and Eagles (incoming grades 1-7).
activities: field trips to local attractions and community partners

source.title: Summer Eagle Camp  - Portsmouth Christian Academy

warnings: Only the 2026 season is shown. Its dates (June 15 – August 7, 2026) have already passed as of 2026-10-13. 2027 dates, prices and registration dates are not posted yet.
Registration dates (Feb 6 for current students, Feb 13 for future enrollees and referral campers, Feb 20 for open registration) are given without a year. They are assumed to be 2026.

The page calls this 'eight weeks' of themed programs but does not list each week separately or say whether you can sign up for single weeks. It is recorded here as one session covering the whole date range.
The page also mentions a separate Summer Kaleidoscope program (sports, fine arts, STEAM, tutoring). That program is not included in this listing.
unknowns: Price per week or per session (the page links to a general Tuition page)
Whether you can sign up for single weeks and what each weekly theme is
Whether extended care (before or after camp) is offered in summer
Whether lunch or snacks are included
Transportation for field trips or to and from camp
Support for campers with special needs
Exact upper age limit (only 'incoming 7th Graders' is stated)

changes: Confirmed groups, 2026 dates (June 15 to August 7), activities and address on the camp page; the 2026 program guidebook PDF agrees and gives no prices.

Removed the single June 15 to August 7 session: the camp sells eight themed weeks but does not post each week's dates or a price, so a season-long session would mislead. The 2026 dates are in the description instead.
Set religious_affiliation Christian (the page says 'Christ-centered community').
